Namespace Here.Explore.Maui.Models.Search

Classes

Address

Address information.

AddressQuery

An address-based search (forward geocoding) query, e.g. "Invalidenstraße 116, Berlin". Excludes POI names — use TextQuery when a POI name is included. When AreaCenter is null the query is unbiased.

CategoryQuery

A category-based search query. Note: when AreaCenter is null the underlying SDK still requires an area center on both platforms, so results are biased toward (0, 0) — pass a center for location-relevant results.

Contact

Contact information for a place.

OpeningHours

TextQuery

A text-based search query. Note: when AreaCenter is null the underlying SDK still requires an area center on both platforms, so results are biased toward (0, 0) — pass a center for location-relevant results.
